description:
Job Description:- 
 At least 2+ years of experience with UI (HTML, CSS and JavaScript) 
 Experience with 3rd party libraries for DOM manipulation (jQuery is preferred), AJAX / JSON 
 Optimization, cross-browser functional code, JavaScript event model 
 Experience building modular JavaScript using AMD 
 Experience with preprocessors (LESS and/or SASS), write efficient selectors, CSS rules and best practices 
 Exposure to web-based mobile UI development 
 Knowledge of Security (XSS, CSRF prevention ), optimizing pages for performance 
 Writing/understanding semantic markup 
 Rapid-development workflow technologies (ie: Grunt) 
 Experience with version control (SVN, Git preferred) 
 ARIA tags, WCAG 2.0 
 At least 2+ years of experience in software development life cycle. 
 At least 2+ years of experience in Project life cycle activities on development and maintenance projects. 
 At least 2+ years of experience in Design and architecture review. 
 At least 2+ years of experience in software development life cycle. 
 Ability to work in team in diverse/ multiple stakeholder environment 
 Experience in Digital domain 
 Analytical skills 
 Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment 
 

 
 Basic Qualifications :- 
 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 At least 4 years of experience within the Information Technologies. 
 
 ** U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply . We are unable to sponsor at this time. 
 Note:- 
 This is a  FULL TIME   job oppurtunity.
 Only  US Citizen ,  Green Card Holder ,  GC-EAD ,  H4-EAD ,  L2-EAD ,  TN VIsa  can apply.
 No  OPT-EAD  &  H1-B   for this position.
 Please mention your Visa Status in your  email   or  resume .
